diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~14% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (10 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.119), which favours a robust combination.
